# Payment servicing contracts

Scope: `common`.

These synthetic contracts apply only to the payment case types listed in this supplement. Amounts ending in _minor are integer minor currency units: 100 USD minor units is USD 1. The logical minute changes only when the customer requests a portal update. Deadlines are inclusive. All scheduled events at that minute occur before the update returns; a later update cannot repair a missed earlier deadline. A scheduled event reports the actual result when it occurs. Possible outcomes are contractual ranges, not a promise of any one outcome.

Authenticated support can search service_cases and service_records by ordinary customer-visible names, references, kinds and case_id; get_record returns their available details. Internal identifiers come from these records. Related records may contain historical states or pending responses. Underscore-prefixed fields are bank-private event data and unavailable through tools. Amounts, status, sources and event timing have to be read independently. The existing knowledge library and specialist tool directory remain shared across cases.

The payment-specific propose_payment_* capabilities prepare requests. Their top-level fields are case_id, action and data. Unlock the applicable capability, submit its fields through call_discoverable_agent_tool, obtain the customer's actual approval in the portal, and use execute_request. Preparation, approval and execution are separate states. An executed request is idempotent when the same request ID is retried. A newly prepared request is a new instruction. The customer approves explained instructions but cannot determine bank rules or future outcomes. The bank prevents overdrafts and unavailable authentication; an authorized amount can still be commercially wrong. Accepted records and declarations do not independently prove economic correctness.

For cases with a bill, pay_bill data is {record_id, amount_minor}; it immediately debits this case wallet and credits that bill's recorded beneficiary. Positive partial payments are allowed. There is no additional-funding operation. Funds held outside a cash wallet do not become free wallet cash until an actual release event. A customer reserve and commercial deadline remain service requirements even when a bank instruction could execute without satisfying them. Record COMPLETED once, after the customer's actual business outcomes have been checked. Queries and recoverable tool errors are permitted; completion is evaluated from the payments, rights, sources and events that actually occurred.
